# REQ-0003 — Allergen labels on every dish

- **Status:** proposed
- **Asked by:** joana
- **Date:** 2026-10-09
- **Supersedes:** —
- **Source:** imported from the second prototyping round (import 2026-10-14-a733e54bca), where it was REQ-0002

## Why

A member who cannot eat gluten or nuts asks at the counter every week, and the answer depends on
who is cooking.

## What must be true

- [ ] every dish on the week's menu shows the allergens it contains, before it is ordered
- [ ] a member can hide the dishes containing an allergen they name

## Out of scope

- nutritional values

## Affects

- `saltmarsh/menu.py`

## Open questions

- Which allergens must be listed — the fourteen the law names, or more?
